## Phase 15: Decide what to post

### Handoff mode (`--handoff <file>`)

Unattended (e.g. `/pr-gated-fixer`): skip the question and Phase 16. Write every Confirmed + Probable
finding (incl. Codex-only Probable) as a JSON array to `<file>`, print `N findings handed off`, stop.
Detection only — the caller owns the fix pipeline.

### Interactive mode (default)

Ask, in plain prose, which findings to post (finding numbers, `all confirmed`, `all confirmed + probable`,
or `none`), noting that /humanizer + stop-slop run before posting. Wait for the reply; `none`/skip → Phase 16
may still submit a body-only LGTM review (zero inline comments), otherwise mark complete with nothing posted.
Skip this entirely under a valid watcher policy (`references/retro.md` → "Delegated authority policy"):
Phase 15 records the authorization reference instead, and Phase 16 posts only within its granted scope.

## Phase 16: Post (only on explicit confirmation)

Full preparation mechanics — comment format, /humanizer + stop-slop, anchors, post-plan, and watch
ledger — live in `references/retro.md` ("Phase 16: Post"). `scripts/review/post_review.py` is the only
posting path; it owns report completeness, head freshness, foreign-PR compliance, the mandatory
scorecard append, and the `compiled -> posted` transition. The single `COMMENT` review always carries a
review body, so a zero-selected round posts that body alone as an LGTM. Never post a finding the user
didn't select or cast a verdict here (Phase 18 owns that); authenticated failures refuse closed with an
exact fix.
When the PR author isn't the reviewing user and the run isn't `--handoff`, close the phase by emitting the reviewer hand-test script — trigger, derivation, and output contract in `references/hand-test.md`.
Completion: the review is submitted (selected findings inline, or the body alone), the task list tracks
each posted comment, the watch ledger is written, and (non-own-PR, non-handoff) the hand-test script is
printed and saved.

## Phase 17: Watch for resolution (self-paced loop)

Optional and adapter-resolved (never a scheduled successor); each tick persists fates through `scripts/review/record_verifier_outcome.py` — see `references/retro.md` ("Phase 17: Watch").
Completion: every posted comment is `fixed` or `deferred`, or the PR merged/closed mid-watch.

## Phase 18: Conclude (comment-only)

Reached only after every posted finding has an evidence-backed verifier fate. The terminal rules live in
`references/retro.md` ("Phase 18: Conclude"): foreign PRs stay comment-only, and the outcome writer
records `converged` or `declined`; on a foreign PR it never casts approve/request-changes verdicts.
